name: Chuu
source:
[spoiler]One of the evil nine-tailed Kitsune's, Genkou's tails. A youkai residing in Kamizawa. He schemes of world domination. Subordinate of Ten, when he was a human his name was kumono Shuusuke.
Compared to his allies, his war potential is one of the lowest, but he's very skilled at manipulating everyone else to his own benefit and managing. However, his own social status as Kumono Shuusuke is what's most crucial for Ten.[/spoiler]
